name: 1574-deepqueue-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- the ungated re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies. Same weights, same config.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 500 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no shared prefix -- every prompt EXACTLY 2048 tokens and every generation EXACTLY 256, sent to /v1/completions (the text route, not the chat route). Seed 42.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter document summarizer handling 128 concurrent long-form requests with short summaries on a single GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at commit 04b262cd91cbcb6b7ec1e096cf6e00631f2c4ead
#   (`git describe --tags` = v0.3.2-36-g04b262cd91c).
#
# Flat `key: value` only. A nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine then runs
# without the mechanism this file declares.

# NousResearch's ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` (Llama 3.1 Community
# License). Same weights, same config.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# 8192, the window Llama 3.1 was trained on before its rope scaling extends it. Prompt 2048 +
# output 256 fits many times over, and the 131072 config value is not left to size the request pool.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
chunked-prefill-size: -1
max-prefill-tokens: 16384
random-seed: 42
